results.title: A nuclear Philippines in six years? OECD’s nuclear chief isn’t convinced.
results.content: The head of the OECD's Nuclear Energy Agency casts doubt on the Philippines' 2032 nuclear target, saying that getting its first reactor operating will likely take longer than six years

results.title: [In This Economy] Pax Silica: What’s the Philippines’ trump card?
results.content: US President Donald Trump’s visit to the Philippines this month gives President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. a good occasion to explain what we’re negotiating for on Pax Silica
